falsification_tests: A cycle of this study run under any other discipline; a test entering a cycle trace without a prior registration carrying its falsifier and verdict rule; a ranking record filed without its sensitivity statement; a kill criterion firing on the record without the loop closing.
claims.text: The five-step loop registered in spec.md section 2 (explicit hypothesis sets including the absorbing verdicts; advance registration with falsifier, null, and control; ranking by expected information gain per unit cost with the sensitivity printed beside the ranking; blinded or held-out scoring wherever the test allows, under the five-rung preference order; a posterior trace with the supported / refuted / indeterminate / exhausted stopping rules) is the operating discipline of this study, and the five kill criteria of spec.md section 4 are registered with it. Does not establish: that the loop's rankings are correct, that expected information gain is measurable for decipherment questions, or that any test outcome under the loop is a decipherment result; the loop is an operating discipline, labelled in spec.md section 1 as a designed transfer with no decipherment track record.

falsification_tests: The registration's NEGATIVE conditions (right-model median advantage below the frozen 0.05 margin for either donor, or the wrong-model or shuffle medians within half the right-model median), or its INDETERMINATE conditions (the donors' evaluations disagreeing; positional recovery not measurable for either donor while the predictor condition is positive for both); each is a complete outcome of the test, and a NEGATIVE outcome closes the positive internal-structure reading of the Indus corpus at this shape as below identifiability.
claims.text: At the Indus corpus profile, the program's structural statistics are identifiable (test I-1): under the registration filed at records/cycle-1-registration-2026-11-26.md section 2, two donor corpora of known structure (Meroitic from the pinned Kovetsky build; Latin from a pinned public-domain text), reshaped to the Indus profile (artifact count, token count, per-artifact length distribution, duplication rate) and ciphered, return, under the right-model condition, a G-IND-form predictor advantage and L3 positional-restriction recovery materially above the wrong-model and shuffle conditions, by the margins the registration fixes, at 1x scale. Does not establish: anything about the Indus language, its family, or any sign's value; the test calibrates what methods of the program's kind can extract from a corpus of this shape, on corpora whose structure is known; the Indus corpus itself is not scored by it.

claims.text: The loop's kill criteria are evaluated at every cycle close, on the record: each cycle of this study closes with a filed evaluation of the five kill criteria of spec.md section 4 against the cycle's trace (information exhaustion; total blockage; ranking collapse; null yield, against the minimum the cycle's registration set in advance; integrity tripwire), and if any criterion fires, the loop closes on the record and does not run a further cycle.
